OK_patterns.pattern: Single-query base with optional `branch_id` filter. Returns Eloquent builder for chaining. No N+1.

Wave 3c heal: TZ-aware Paris-day boundary using `whereBetween [startUtc, endUtcExclusive)`. Builder cloned 10× for `pending`/`accept`/`preparing`/etc. counts. Each cloned scope adds a `where status` predicate.
OK_patterns.verdict: 10 queries per pageload. Could be reduced to 1 query with `SELECT status, COUNT(*) ... GROUP BY status` but acceptable for non-hot path (dashboard refresh 30-60s polling). Wave 3c TZ heal is correct (commit 148dbebce visible).

OK_patterns.pattern: Two queries per refresh: sum(total) WHERE paid + count(*). Both filtered by [startUtc,endUtcExclusive) on order_datetime — TZ-aware. Uses `idx_orders_datetime` index per comment.
withCount + orderBy 'orders_count' + limit 8. Single SQL with subquery COUNT.
with('user') eager load. orderBy + get + map.
ActionLog::with('user') + orderBy + limit 50. F-A3 heal scoped branch_id to actor's branch.

questionable_patterns.pattern: `->get()` (FULL day's orders into memory) then 4× `$orders->count()` / `$orders->where('source', ...)->count()` in PHP collection — NOT SQL.
questionable_patterns.issue: Pulls every column of every order for the day into memory just to count by source. At Le Cayenne single-resto V1 scale (~200 orders/day) this is fine. At any scaling event (multi-tenant V2 or busy chain location 1000+ orders/day) this becomes a memory drag.
questionable_patterns.fix: Replace with single `SELECT source, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_datetime BETWEEN ... GROUP BY source` SQL.

questionable_patterns.pattern: Loop over $timeArray with `(clone $order)->get()->count()` — looks like a per-time-bucket count via get-then-count. Suspect N+queries pattern.
questionable_patterns.fix: Need full read to assess. Defer P2.
